query: Which statistical and causal-inference designs (panel, quasi-experimental, cluster trials) best balance internal validity and feasibility given our sample, timing and heterogeneity?

response.query: Which statistical and causal-inference designs (panel, quasi-experimental, cluster trials) best balance internal validity and feasibility given our sample, timing and heterogeneity?
response.answer: For balancing internal validity and feasibility, quasi-experimental designs like difference-in-differences are often best, especially when randomization isn't feasible. Cluster trials can also work well for heterogeneous samples. Panel designs offer strong internal validity over time.
